d:
The top 6 hustlers deliver their iconic hooks one last time in the finale, showcasing their unique styles and journeys. From uplifting anthems and raw street vibes to nostalgic reflections and commanding declarations, each hook leaves a powerful mark, celebrating their artistry and evolution.
